items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: I know him good, uptown there, son White.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, sure, the bass drummer...
Yeah, they take old son, few clothes, and you got this boy here...oh, what's this boy's name right now? I know him good, uptown there, son White. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Son White, he's an old timer.
